spec.name: omp-badge-always-shows
spec.intent: Census @8d0a7283 (design at 8d0a7283; notebook at 8d0a7283 plus the decision note "mav's cell restates its role"); every path is repo-relative on the plan's line. A line number, count or observed behaviour cited here is a measurement at that commit: re-derive it if its path changed since. Add no new test file: a new one must be classified in packages/canon/test/gate-convicts.test.ts, which no unit of this plan owns; extend the test files named in outputs. Realize persona badge on omp: the running persona's name and mark visible in its own top-level interactive session, and where it cannot appear in place, somewhere visible rather than not at all. Two gaps at 8d0a7283 in the badge module, ompPersonaBadgeExtensions (packages/forge/src/adapters/omp/render.ts:1659-1692). (1) Its session_start handler reads ctx.agent.kind unguarded (:1684); omp added ctx.agent in 18.3.2, so on an older omp the handler throws 'undefined is not an object (evaluating ctx.agent.kind)' at launch (note 'persona badge needs omp 18.3.2 or later'); the guard modules already read ctx.agent?.kind (:672). On an omp without ctx.agent the module throws nothing: it shows the badge where it can still tell a top-level interactive session, and where it cannot, it says once, in one line, why it shows none. (2) Where the host's statusLine is an alias to a mapping written elsewhere that sets showHookStatus: false, install cannot show the hook status row (packages/forge/src/deploy/status-line.ts:669-680: state refused, hookRowShown false), and the badge, which omp draws in that row, shows nowhere (finding 'badge-always-visible rework (f8732965): shard achieved; alias-to-anchor statusLine is the one shape left out of reach'). Make the badge reach such a session another visible way omp offers, taking nothing away from what the host shows there. Decide it in what omp loads, the module: packages/forge/src/cli/commands/install.ts and status-line.ts are not this unit's. packages/cli/README.md:215-219 says the badge shows nowhere in that case: say what the operator sees now. Keep the exported names and signatures of render.ts. Add a patch changeset for @cratylus/forge and cratylus.
accept: in packages/forge, `pnpm exec vitest run test/adapters/omp.test.ts` exits 0, including a case that runs the emitted badge module's session_start handler against a stub context with hasUI true and no `agent` and sees it throw nothing (at 8d0a7283 it throws), and a case where the host's status row is hidden by a statusLine alias and the handler, for a top-level interactive session, puts the badge text on a UI surface other than setStatus's row (at 8d0a7283 setStatus is its only surface)
a subagent context (agent.kind 'sub') still gets no badge on any surface, in the same test run
`git diff <the commit the unit's work starts from> --stat` lists no file under packages/forge/src but packages/forge/src/adapters/omp/render.ts
